title: FailCon 2011 - Uber Case Study
summary: Travis Kalanick's talk at FailCon 2011 about his earlier failed startups, given as a case study before Uber's rise. It describes lessons from those ventures.
why: HN commenters recommend it for insight into Kalanick's background and how his past failures shaped his mindset at Uber.

quote.text: I would really recommend watching this talk[1] TK gave at Failcon back in 2011.
